description: Defines the CallbackVisitor class implementing an HTTP/2 visitor interface, handling HTTP/2 events via callbacks, managing stream states, and interfacing with nghttp2 library structures.

classes.name: CallbackVisitor
classes.description: Implements an HTTP/2 visitor that handles events and callbacks for HTTP/2 streams, utilizing nghttp2 callbacks and managing stream states.

methods.name: CallbackVisitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the visitor with perspective, callbacks, and user data.

methods.name: OnReadyToSend
methods.description: Called when ready to send serialized data.

methods.name: OnBeginHeadersForStream
methods.description: Called at start of headers for a stream.

methods.name: OnHeaderForStream
methods.description: Processes a header for a stream.

methods.name: OnEndHeadersForStream
methods.description: Indicates end of headers for a stream.

methods.name: OnBeginDataForStream
methods.description: Called at start of data for a stream.

methods.name: OnBeforeFrameSent
methods.description: Called before a frame is sent.

methods.name: OnFrameSent
methods.description: Called after a frame is sent.

methods.name: OnBeginMetadataForStream
methods.description: Indicates start of metadata for a stream.

methods.name: OnMetadataEndForStream
methods.description: Indicates end of metadata for a stream.
